fewShots.question: Show up to 20 providers in Cardiology.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (p:Provider) WHERE p.specialty = 'Cardiology' RETURN p.provider_id, p.display_name, p.specialty, p.department LIMIT 20

fewShots.question: Resolve Nancy White age 63 to a patient identifier before reviewing her records.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (pat:Patient) WHERE pat.first_name = 'Nancy' AND pat.last_name = 'White' AND pat.age = 63 RETURN DISTINCT pat.patient_id, pat.first_name, pat.last_name, pat.age, pat.gender LIMIT 20

fewShots.question: List up to 20 patients with medication adherence data so I can select one.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (ma:MedicationAdherence)-[:adherenceFor]->(pat:Patient) RETURN DISTINCT pat.patient_id, pat.first_name, pat.last_name, pat.age, pat.gender LIMIT 20

fewShots.question: Show medication-level adherence with drug classes for the patient_id I selected.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (ma:MedicationAdherence)-[:adherenceFor]->(pat:Patient), (ma)-[:adherenceMedication]->(med:Medication) WHERE pat.patient_id = '<selected_patient_id>' RETURN pat.patient_id, med.medication_key, med.drug_class, med.medication_name, med.therapeutic_area, ma.adherence_category, ma.pdc_score, ma.gap_days LIMIT 20

fewShots.question: Show up to 10 non-adherent chronic medication records with the patient and medication.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (ma:MedicationAdherence)-[:adherenceFor]->(pat:Patient), (ma)-[:adherenceMedication]->(med:Medication) WHERE ma.adherence_category = 'Non-Adherent' AND med.is_chronic = 1 RETURN pat.patient_id, pat.first_name, pat.last_name, med.medication_name, med.drug_class, ma.pdc_score, ma.gap_days LIMIT 10

fewShots.question: Show up to 10 encounters treated by the provider_id I selected.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (e:Encounter)-[:treatedBy]->(p:Provider) WHERE p.provider_id = '<selected_provider_id>' RETURN p.provider_id, e.encounter_key, e.encounter_id, e.encounter_type, e.readmission_flag, e.readmission_risk_category LIMIT 10

fewShots.question: Show up to 10 denied claims for the payer_id I selected, with the submitting providers.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (c:Claim)-[:ClaimHasPayer]->(pay:Payer), (c)-[:submittedBy]->(p:Provider) WHERE pay.payer_id = '<selected_payer_id>' AND c.denial_flag = 1 RETURN c.claim_key, c.claim_id, pay.payer_name, p.provider_id, p.display_name, c.primary_denial_reason, c.recommended_action LIMIT 10

fewShots.question: Count claims by denial flag for the payer_id I selected.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (c:Claim)-[:ClaimHasPayer]->(pay:Payer) WHERE pay.payer_id = '<selected_payer_id>' LET denialFlag = c.denial_flag RETURN denialFlag, count(c) AS claim_count GROUP BY denialFlag LIMIT 20

fewShots.question: For the payer_id I selected, count prescriptions by drug class.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (rx:Prescription)-[:PrescriptionHasPayer]->(pay:Payer), (rx)-[:dispenses]->(med:Medication) WHERE pay.payer_id = '<selected_payer_id>' LET payerId = pay.payer_id, drugClass = med.drug_class RETURN payerId, drugClass, count(rx) AS prescription_count GROUP BY payerId, drugClass ORDER BY prescription_count DESC LIMIT 20

fewShots.question: Show up to 10 distinct high-readmission-risk encounters associated with the payer_id I selected, not an observed readmission rate.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (c:Claim)-[:billsFor]->(e:Encounter), (c)-[:ClaimHasPayer]->(pay:Payer) WHERE pay.payer_id = '<selected_payer_id>' AND e.readmission_risk_category = 'High' RETURN DISTINCT pay.payer_id, e.encounter_key, e.encounter_id, e.readmission_risk_category LIMIT 10

fewShots.question: For the selected patient_id, show up to 10 diagnoses and the encounters in which they occurred.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (pd:PatientDiagnosis)-[:affects]->(pat:Patient), (pd)-[:references]->(d:Diagnosis), (pd)-[:occursIn]->(e:Encounter) WHERE pat.patient_id = '<selected_patient_id>' RETURN pd.fact_diagnosis_key, pat.patient_id, d.icd_code, d.icd_description, e.encounter_id LIMIT 10

fewShots.question: Show up to 10 prescriptions by Cardiology providers with the patient receiving each prescription.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (rx:Prescription)-[:prescribedBy]->(p:Provider), (rx)-[:serves]->(pat:Patient) WHERE p.specialty = 'Cardiology' RETURN rx.prescription_key, rx.prescription_id, p.provider_id, p.display_name, pat.patient_id, rx.patient_copay LIMIT 10

fewShots.question: For the selected prescription_id, show its originating encounter.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (rx:Prescription)-[:originatesFrom]->(e:Encounter) WHERE rx.prescription_id = '<selected_prescription_id>' RETURN rx.prescription_id, e.encounter_key, e.encounter_id, e.encounter_type LIMIT 10

fewShots.question: For the selected claim_id, show its patient and billed encounter.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (c:Claim)-[:covers]->(pat:Patient), (c)-[:billsFor]->(e:Encounter) WHERE c.claim_id = '<selected_claim_id>' RETURN c.claim_key, c.claim_id, pat.patient_id, e.encounter_key, e.encounter_id, c.claim_status LIMIT 10

fewShots.question: For the selected patient_id, show the community risk profile.
fewShots.answer: MATCH (pat:Patient)-[:livesIn]->(ch:CommunityHealth) WHERE pat.patient_id = '<selected_patient_id>' RETURN pat.patient_id, ch.zip_code, ch.risk_tier, ch.poverty_rate, ch.transportation_score, ch.food_desert_flag LIMIT 10
